INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Glucose and oxygen

2. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.

3. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.

5. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.

7. B — Producers

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

11. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. B — newton (N)

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Laboratory apparatus and instruments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Mixtures; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Acids, Bases and Indicators; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Reproductive System; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
